entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
At Base Woodbourne, the Command and Recruit Training Squadron (CRTS) is responsible for training new recruits and introducing them to life in the Royal New Zealand Air Force. Through challenge, support, and discipline, recruits are encouraged to put their best foot forward from day one.
 
On this morning recruits muster and warm up before a physical training session as part of CRTS’s 13-week recruit training programme, designed to develop the next generation of aviators.
 
After completing their initial recruit training, they will move on to specialist trade training as valued members of our Air Force, ready to meet the challenges of tomorrow.
